## Raw second transcription

```yaml
```yaml
lines:
  - id: dependent.one
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One (this person)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: param, ref: dependent.one}

  - id: dependent.h_zero
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ss.zero}

  - id: dependent.h_cent
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: sc.one_cent}

  # ---------------- Step 1: qualifying child ----------------
  - id: dependent.h_rel_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Son, daughter, stepchild, foster child, brother, sister, stepbrother, stepsister, half brother, half sister, or a descendant of any of them"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling_descendant"}]}

  - id: dependent.h_age_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Under age 19 and younger than you (or your spouse); or under age 24, a full-time student and younger; or any age and permanently and totally disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: qc.student_age_limit}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.student, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.younger, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.disabled, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_resid
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lived with you for more than half of 2025 (or a kidnapped child treated as meeting the residency test)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.kidnapped, {const: true}]}
    note: "Pub. 501 lets a child presumed kidnapped be treated as meeting the residency test under further conditions the inputs do not ask; the kidnapped answer is read as meeting them."

  - id: dependent.h_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Meets the conditions to be your qualifying child (Step 1)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.self_support, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_resid, {const: true}]}
    note: "The tiebreaker rules for a child who is also the qualifying child of another person depend on facts (parentage, AGI) not in the inputs; the filer is treated as the one claiming the child."

  # ---------------- Step 4: qualifying relative ----------------
  - id: dependent.h_rel_qr
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Related to you (or, on a joint return, your spouse) in a way that need not live with you"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "child"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent_relative"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "in_law"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.spouse_relative, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qr_household
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Any other person who lived with you all year as a member of your household if your relationship didn't violate local law"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "household_member"}]}
        - op: test
          all:
            - op: test
              any:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "other"}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "sibling_descendant"}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.qr_all_year, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.lawful, {const: true}]}
    note: "The household_member answer is defined as a person who lived with you all year with a lawful relationship, so it is taken as meeting this test without the follow-up questions."

  - id: dependent.h_qr_not_qc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Wasn't a qualifying child of any taxpayer for 2025"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_claimant, {const: false}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.other_nontaxpayer, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_qr
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Meets the conditions to be your qualifying relative (Step 4)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_not_qc, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qr, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr_household, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.gross_income, {param: qr.gross_income_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.supported, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.multiple_support]
    note: "The sheltered-workshop exception to the gross income test is not computed; the gross income entered is compared with $5,200."

  # ---------------- Steps 2 and 4: dependent ----------------
  - id: dependent.h_citizen_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. resident alien, or a resident of Canada or Mexico"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.canada_mexico, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_filer_ok
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Filing a joint return, or you can't be claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 return"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      any:
        - {op: test, eq: [f1040.status, {const: "mfj"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [sa.dependent, {const: false}]}
    note: "sa.dependent also covers dual-status aliens; it is used as the Step 2 question 4 / Step 4 question 5 answer."

  - id: dependent.claimed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "You can claim this person as a dependent"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qr, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_citizen_ok, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_filer_ok, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.married, dependent.divorced_rule]

  # ---------------- Steps 3 and 5: CTC / ODC ----------------
  - id: dependent.ctc_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying child for the child tax credit (Step 3)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: ctc.age_limit}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.work_ssn, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.ctc_ssn, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.odc_person
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifies you for the credit for other dependents"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.citizen, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [household.all_tin, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}
    note: "household.all_tin is read as the Step 5 question 1 condition (you, and your spouse if filing jointly, have an SSN or ITIN, issued or applied for, by the due date)."

  - id: dependent.h_ctc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,200"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: ctc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.ctc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Child tax credit amount for this child (Schedule 8812, line 5 share)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_ctc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.h_odc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$500"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: odc.per_dependent}

  - id: dependent.odc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Credit for other dependents amount for this person (Schedule 8812, line 7 share)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_odc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.odc_person, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.h_actc_per
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$1,700"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: actc.per_child}

  - id: dependent.actc_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Additional child tax credit amount for this child (Schedule 8812, line 16b share)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_actc_per}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.ctc_child, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  # ---------------- Head of household ----------------
  - id: dependent.hoh_test1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Test 1: your parent whom you can claim as a dependent, for whose main home all year you paid over half the cost"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.relationship, {const: "parent"}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.parent_home_paid, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.hoh_test2
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Test 2: lived with you for more than half the year and is your dependent (other than only by living with you all year) or your unmarried qualifying child"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_resid, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qr, {const: true}]}
    note: "Married qualifying children, children of divorced or separated parents and multiple support dependents are refused at dependent.claimed/h_qr, so Test 2 items 3 and 4 and the exclusions are not computed."

  - id: dependent.hoh_absence
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Test 2 person whose time with you counts an absence from which return was not expected or during which the home was not kept up"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.hoh_test2, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.absence_no_return, {const: true}]}

  # ---------------- EIC ----------------
  - id: dependent.eic_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying child for the EIC"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_rel_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_age_qc, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.joint_return, {const: false}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.us_half, {const: true}]}
            - {op: test, eq: [dependent.kidnapped, {const: true}]}
    refuses: [dependent.married, dependent.divorced_rule]
    note: "Tiebreaker rules for a child of more than one person are not computed; the filer is treated as claiming the child."

  - id: dependent.eic_ssn_child
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "EIC qualifying child who has a valid SSN"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_child, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.eic_ssn, {const: true}]}

  # ---------------- Form 2441 ----------------
  - id: dependent.dc_qp
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Qualifying person for Form 2441"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_qc, {const: true}]}
                - op: test
                  any:
                    - {op: test, lt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                    - op: test
                      all:
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_under13, {const: true}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
                - {op: test, ge: [dependent.months, {const: 7, type: Count}]}
    note: "Persons who would be dependents except for gross income, a joint return or the filer's dependency are handled by the f2441.nondependent gate, not here."

  - id: dependent.h_dc_cent
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "One cent if a qualifying person, else zero"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_cent}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  - id: dependent.dc_count
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of qualifying persons this person counts for (1 or 0)"
    type: Count
    expr: {op: percent_floor, part: dependent.h_dc_cent, whole: {const: 100}, cap: 1}
    note: "No atom selects a Count conditionally; 1 cent over 100 cents as a whole-number percentage yields 1, zero yields 0."

  - id: dependent.dc_line2d
    printed: "2(d)"
    label: "Qualified expenses you incurred and paid in 2025 for the person listed in column (a)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.dc_paid}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp

  - id: dependent.dc_line2c
    printed: "2(c)"
    label: "Check here if the qualifying person was over age 12 and was disabled"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_qp, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_incapable, {const: true}]}
        - op: test
          any:
            - {op: test, gt: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
            - op: test
              all:
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.age, {param: dc.child_age}]}
                - {op: test, eq: [dependent.dc_over12_care, {const: true}]}
    shown_when: dependent.dc_qp
    note: "A person 14 or older at year end was over 12 for all of 2025; a person who turned 13 in 2025 is checked only if care included on line 2 was provided at 13 or older (dc_over12_care)."

  # ---------------- Premium tax credit ----------------
  - id: dependent.h_ptc_counted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Dependent required to file whose modified AGI is counted on Form 8962, line 2b"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.ptc_files, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.ptc_magi_counted
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "This dependent's modified AGI counted on Worksheet 1-2 (Form 8962, line 2b)"
    type: Dollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counted, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.ptc_magi}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_ptc_counted, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}

  # ---------------- Form 8863 Part III ----------------
  - id: dependent.h_edu_student
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Claimed dependent with qualified education expenses and a Form 1098-T (or excepted)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.claimed, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_1098t, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Lines 23 to 26 route to lines 27 through 30, and the AOC TIN and EIN requirements are met"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line23, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line24, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line25, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line26, {const: false}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_ein, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_tin_issued, {const: true}]}
    note: "Without the institution's EIN or a student TIN issued by the due date the AOC can't be claimed; the student is then taken to line 31."

  - id: dependent.h_edu_llc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Student for whom line 31 is completed"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_student, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_tin_issued, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_ws1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 1 (AOC): tuition, required fees and course materials"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_inst, dependent.edu_mat]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_adj
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 3: total adjustments (lines 2a, 2b and 2c)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_a2025, dependent.edu_a2026, dependent.edu_refunds]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_has_adj
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Any tax-free educational assistance or refunds"
    type: Bool
    expr: {op: test, gt: [dependent.h_edu_adj, {const: 0}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_over_refused
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjustments exceed an academic period's expenses (worksheet must be done per period)"
    type: Bool
    expr:
      op: test
      all:
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_has_adj, {const: true}]}
        - {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_over, {const: true}]}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_ws4_aoc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 4 (AOC): subtract line 3 from line 1; if zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.h_edu_ws1, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_ws4_llc
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "AQEE Worksheet line 4 (LLC): subtract line 3 from line 1; if zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_inst, take: dependent.h_edu_adj}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_cap
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.expense_cap}

  - id: dependent.h_aoc_band
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "$2,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: param, ref: aoc.full_band}

  - id: dependent.h_edu_l27_amount
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses, not more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: smaller_of, of: [dependent.h_edu_ws4_aoc, dependent.h_aoc_cap]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line27
    printed: "27"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Don't enter more than $4,000"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_edu_l27_amount}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_aoc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line28
    printed: "28"
    label: "Subtract $2,000 from line 27. If zero or less, enter -0-"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: subtract_floor0, from: dependent.edu_line27, take: {param: aoc.full_band}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line29
    printed: "29"
    label: "Multiply line 28 by 25% (0.25)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: multiply_rate, amount: dependent.edu_line28, rate: {param: aoc.second_rate}}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.h_edu_l29_plus
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Add $2,000 to the amount on line 29"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr: {op: sum, of: [dependent.edu_line29, dependent.h_aoc_band]}

  - id: dependent.edu_line30
    printed: "30"
    label: "If line 28 is zero, enter the amount from line 27. Otherwise, add $2,000 to the amount on line 29 and enter the result"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}, then: dependent.edu_line27}
        - {guard: {op: test, gt: [dependent.edu_line28, {const: 0}]}, then: dependent.h_edu_l29_plus}
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_aoc

  - id: dependent.edu_line31
    printed: "31"
    label: "Adjusted qualified education expenses (see instructions). Include the total of all amounts from all Parts III, line 31, on Part II, line 10"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: choose
      alternatives:
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: true}]}, then: dependent.h_edu_ws4_llc}
        - {guard: {op: test, eq: [dependent.h_edu_llc, {const: false}]}, then: dependent.h_zero}
    refuses: [dependent.h_edu_over_refused]
    shown_when: dependent.h_edu_llc
